question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY dl.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales_by_region_sku
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 销量最高单品
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.brand,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
    bs.brand AS 品牌
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_net_amount, 0) > 0.10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
WITH terminal_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS terminal_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(terminal_net_amount) AS avg_net_amount
    FROM terminal_avg
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数量
FROM terminal_avg ta
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ta.terminal_net_amount > oa.avg_net_amount

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category AS 品类,
    p.sku_name AS 单品,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
)
SELECT 品类, 单品, 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY 品类, 销量 DESC

    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    a.category AS 品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b

    AND a.year_month = '2026-08' 
    AND b.year_month = '2026-07'

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低

  JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY dl.region
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(净销额) AS 总净销额 FROM region_sales
)

    d.year_month,

    SELECT DISTINCT s.outlet_id, s.sku_id, o.channel
    FROM fact_sales s
    INNER JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    INNER JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    INNER JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
)
SELECT 
    o.channel AS 渠道,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (fs.outlet_id, fs.sku_id))::DOUBLE 
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_rel fr WHERE fr.outlet_id IN (SELECT outlet_id FROM dim_outlet WHERE channel = o.channel)), 0) AS 动销率
FROM filtered_sales fs
INNER JOIN dim_outlet o ON fs.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
GROUP BY o.channel
ORDER BY o.channel

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS active_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
    mi.total_qty_on_hand / NULLIF(ms.total_qty / NULLIF(ms.active_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM monthly_inventory mi
JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON mi.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_month AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'

),

        dl.region,

    FROM fact_sales s

    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(cm.region, lym.region) AS 大区,
    (cm.current_net_amount - lym.last_year_net_amount) / NULLIF(lym.last_year_net_amount, 0) AS 净销额同比增长率
FROM current_month cm
FULL OUTER JOIN last_year_month lym ON cm.region = lym.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo AND d.year_month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09','2025-10','2025-11','2025-12','2026-01','2026-02','2026-03','2026-04','2026-05','2026-06')
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09','2025-10','2025-11','2025-12','2026-01','2026-02','2026-03','2026-04','2026-05','2026-06')
  GROUP BY 1
),
merged AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS ratio
  FROM s JOIN c USING (year_month)
),
periods AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN year_month BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2025-12' THEN '2025H2'
         WHEN year_month BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06' THEN '2026H1'
    END AS period,
    ratio
  FROM merged
  WHERE year_month BETWEEN '2025-07' AND '2026-06'
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN ratio END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN ratio END) AS 费效比提升
FROM periods
